paragraphs.text: White-black ( or WB ), also called Orzhov , is an enemy color pair. Their central conflict is the good of the group ( white ) versus the good of the individual ( black ). White and black share the evergreen keywords lifelink , flying , indestructible , and flash . White-black lends itself to a removal -heavy tempo strategy. The two colors are mutual allies of blue ( ).

White is the color of morality and selflessness, while black is the color of amoral self-interest. Their core conflict is white's for the good of the group versus black's for the good of the individual . White believes in social responsibility, while black believes in meritocracy. Black sees morality as wishful thinking and views white as misguided, while white sees black as dangerously immoral.
There are three main interpretations of white-black philosophy, which can be seen in different characters:
White ends, black means: Immoral actions in service of a righteous or altruistic goal. Here, white-black is the color pair of "the ends justify the means".

White means, black ends: Selfish exploitation of white-aligned systems like religion and politics. Such a character might preach white ideals without believing them, to take advantage of those who believe them.

For the good of one group: Genuine altruism and selflessness, but reserved for a specific group. This white-black version cares for its own people and has no sense of duty or morality toward outsiders.

White and black are mutual allies of blue , the color of perfection through knowledge. Both share blue's striving to become better, although white is focused on societal improvement and black is focused on self-improvement. White's fanaticism combined with black's ruthlessness makes for a stubborn, absolutist color pair, often lacking in empathy. White-black is so sure of its own beliefs that it can fail to consider outside perspectives. It cares deeply for its own priorities but absolutely nothing else.
Examples of White-black heroes include Teysa Karlov and Sorin Markov , while villains include Eriette and Extus Narr .

White and black's moderate level of mechanical overlap makes it relatively easy to design multicolored cards, although the stark philosophical conflict between the two colors can make it difficult to find the right flavor. White-black lends itself to "bleeder" decks, which remove threats and slowly chip away at the opponent's life total .
The following mechanics are shared by white and black.
Death Grasp - combines black X dealing damage spell with white's gain life onto very efficient sorcery.
Mortify - combines white's disenchantment ability with black's creature destruction onto one card with no drawback (i.e. cannot target black creatures).
